intro.title: 1. Agreement and Acceptance
intro.content: These Business Terms of Service govern your registration and use of Jinni as a business — listing a venue, event, or place and managing it through a business account. By submitting an application or using a business dashboard, you agree to these terms, to our Business Privacy Policy, and to our general Terms of Service. If you are entering into these terms on behalf of a business, you confirm that you are authorised to do so. Some terms differ by partnership tier — use the buttons below to read the terms for Verified, Spotlight, or Signature.

tier_selector.title: Choose Your Partnership Tier
tier_selector.subtitle: Select a tier to see the specific terms — pricing, features, placement, and cancellation — that apply to it. The sections below apply to every business on Jinni.

verified.label: Verified (Free)
verified.title: Terms for Verified Listings
verified.intro: A Verified listing is provided free of charge and is the entry-level tier.
points: There is no fee for a Verified listing and no payment obligation.

Verified listings display images sourced automatically from Google during verification; you may not upload your own photos, and opening hours, social links, and highlights are not available at this tier.
You receive a basic view count only; detailed analytics are reserved for paid tiers.

A Verified listing cannot occupy a map zone that is already full. If a zone is full, you must upgrade to Spotlight or Signature to be considered, and a higher-tier business may take priority over a free listing in a contested zone.
Verified listings remain subject to the verification, content, and moderation rules in the common sections below.
We may keep Verified listings free, change their features, or discontinue the tier at our discretion, with notice where appropriate.

spotlight.label: Spotlight ($29/mo)
spotlight.title: Terms for Spotlight Listings
spotlight.intro: A Spotlight listing is a paid subscription of US$29 per month (or local-currency equivalent) and unlocks enhanced features.
points: By subscribing you authorise recurring monthly billing of the Spotlight fee until you cancel.
Spotlight unlocks opening hours, additional images, a full analytics dashboard, and a performance score used to rank listings within a zone.

Zones hold a limited number of listings. A Spotlight listing may take a slot ahead of a free listing in a full zone, and may itself be outranked or displaced by a Signature listing — see “Zones, Placement, and Displacement” below.
If your listing loses its slot, it may be frozen (hidden from travellers) while retaining its data; this is not a refundable service failure.
You may cancel at any time; your listing keeps Spotlight features until the end of the current paid period, after which it may revert to Verified or become inactive.
Fees, features, and availability may change with reasonable notice.

signature.label: Signature ($49/mo)
signature.title: Terms for Signature Listings
signature.intro: A Signature listing is our premium subscription, starting at US$49 per month (or local-currency equivalent). In contested zones the monthly price may be higher as a result of the Zone Auction.
points: By subscribing you authorise recurring monthly billing at your applicable Signature price until you cancel.

Signature unlocks social media links, listing highlights, optional “Hidden Gem” status, owner-uploaded images that we host and serve publicly, Zone Intelligence, and an estimated-revenue figure (an estimate only, not a guarantee of sales).

ZONE AUCTION: where a zone is already held by three Signature listings, entry is decided by an auction. You may submit a maximum monthly bid above the floor price. Winning or defending a slot locks your monthly price for the lock-in period (about three months). Bids and locked prices are binding for that period.

DISPLACEMENT AND DEFENCE: approximately one week before renewal, the lowest-performing Signature in a full zone must beat the current high bid within 72 hours or forfeit its slot. A forfeited or out-bid listing is frozen; it keeps its data and may bid again later.

CANCELLATION: you may cancel a Signature subscription; the slot stays active until the end of the paid period and then becomes available to the next bidder. Auction commitments already won for the current locked period remain payable.
Higher placement reflects tier and bidding, not editorial endorsement, and the Jinni AI assistant does not artificially boost paid listings in its recommendations.

common.title: Eligibility and Your Account
common.content: You must represent a real, lawful business, venue, event, or place that you are authorised to list. When you apply, we create an owner account for you and email you a secure link to set your password. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account, and for ensuring the information you provide is accurate, current, and not misleading.

common.title: Listing Submission and Verification
common.content: Every listing is subject to automated verification and human review before it goes live. Verification may involve checking your submitted details against third-party sources such as Google, your website, TripAdvisor, and Instagram. We may approve, request changes to, waitlist, or reject a listing at our discretion. Approval is not guaranteed, and passing verification is not an endorsement or a warranty about your business.
points: You confirm that you have the right to use all names, text, images, and links you submit.
You must not impersonate another business or submit duplicate listings for the same business.
We may re-review a listing whenever it is edited, and editing a rejected or expired listing returns it to review.

common.title: Your Content and Licence to Jinni
common.content: You retain ownership of the content you submit (descriptions, images, logos, and other materials). You grant Jinni a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, store, reproduce, adapt for display, translate, and publish that content in connection with operating and promoting your listing across Jinni, including in search, map discovery, and the AI assistant. You are responsible for ensuring your content does not infringe the rights of others and complies with applicable law.

common.title: Acceptable Use and Prohibited Conduct
common.content: When using Jinni for Business you must not:
points: Submit false, deceptive, fraudulent, or misleading information, reviews, or imagery.
List a business you do not own or are not authorised to represent, or create duplicate or fingerprint-evading listings.
Manipulate analytics, performance scores, the zone system, or the Zone Auction through fake interactions or automated means.
Upload unlawful, infringing, offensive, or harmful content, or content you have no right to use.
Attempt to circumvent moderation, rejection, or block-list controls.
Use the platform to violate any applicable law or third-party rights.

common.title: Zones, Placement, and Displacement
common.content: Jinni organises listings into geographic zones with a limited number of slots per category. Placement and visibility depend on your tier, your performance score, and (for Signature) bidding. Higher tiers can displace lower tiers, and a displaced listing may be frozen and hidden from travellers while keeping its data. Slot availability, ranking, displacement, and the Zone Auction operate as described in the tier sections above and may be adjusted as we improve the platform. We do not guarantee any particular placement, ranking, visibility, traffic, leads, bookings, or revenue.

common.title: Fees, Billing, and Refunds
common.content: Paid tiers (Spotlight and Signature) are billed in advance on a recurring monthly basis through our third-party payment provider; Signature prices set by the Zone Auction are locked for the lock-in period and are payable for that period. You authorise us and our payment provider to charge your chosen payment method until you cancel. Except where required by law, fees are non-refundable, including where a listing is later frozen, displaced, rejected for breach of these terms, or removed for cause. Taxes, currency conversion, and payment-provider charges may apply. We may change fees with reasonable notice; changes take effect at your next billing cycle.

common.title: Analytics and Performance Data
common.content: Dashboard analytics, performance scores, traffic shares, and estimated revenue are provided for your information only. They are estimates based on on-platform activity, may be incomplete or delayed, and must not be relied upon as a measurement of actual sales or a guarantee of results. We are not liable for business decisions you make based on these figures.

common.title: Suspension, Freezing, and Termination
common.content: We may suspend, freeze, downgrade, remove, or permanently reject a listing, and may disable the associated owner account, if we believe these terms have been breached, if a listing is fraudulent or abusive, if payment fails, or as required to protect Jinni, travellers, or third parties. A permanent rejection for abuse may block future applications associated with your details. You may stop using the service or request removal of your listing at any time; certain records may be retained as described in the Business Privacy Policy. Provisions that by their nature should survive termination (including content licence for already-published material, fees owed, disclaimers, and limitation of liability) will survive.

common.title: Disclaimers
common.content: Jinni for Business is provided “as is” and “as available,” without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. We do not warrant that the service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or secure, that verification will detect every issue, or that listings will generate any particular level of interest, traffic, or revenue.

common.title: Limitation of Liability
common.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Jinni and its affiliates will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for any loss of profits, revenue, goodwill, data, or business opportunities, arising from or related to your use of Jinni for Business. To the extent we are found liable, our total aggregate liability will not exceed the amount you paid to Jinni for the listing in question during the three months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

common.title: Indemnification
common.content: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Jinni and its affiliates from any claims, damages, losses, liabilities, and expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising from your listing, your content, your use of the service, or your breach of these terms or of any law or third-party right.

common.title: Changes to These Terms
common.content: We may update these Business Terms of Service from time to time. When we make material changes we will update the “Last Updated” date and, where appropriate, notify you. Your continued use of Jinni for Business after an update means you accept the revised terms.

common.title: Governing Law and Contact
common.content: These terms are governed by the applicable laws of the jurisdiction in which Jinni operates, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. If you have questions about these Business Terms of Service, please reach us through the Contact page on Jinni.

intro.title: 1. About This Policy
intro.content: This Business Privacy Policy explains how Jinni collects, uses, shares, and protects information relating to businesses and the people who register and manage business listings on Jinni. It applies in addition to our general Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service. Some practices differ depending on your partnership tier — use the buttons below to read the notes that apply to Verified, Spotlight, or Signature listings.

tier_selector.title: Choose Your Partnership Tier
tier_selector.subtitle: Select a tier to see exactly what data we collect, process, and display for that level of listing. The sections after it apply to every business on Jinni.

verified.label: Verified (Free)
verified.title: Privacy Notes for Verified Listings
verified.intro: A Verified listing is free. It is the lightest tier in terms of the data we hold about your business.
points: We do not accept your own uploaded photos for a Verified listing. Instead, images shown on your listing are retrieved automatically from Google Places during verification and stored on our servers.
Opening hours, social media links, and listing highlights are not collected for this tier and are ignored if submitted.
You see only basic analytics — a total view count and a prompt to upgrade. We do not expose detailed engagement metrics to Verified owners.
We still collect and process your core application data (business name, category, address and coordinates, contact details, pricing) and run the verification checks described below.
A Verified listing cannot enter a map zone that is already full; no bidding or auction data is collected for this tier.

spotlight.label: Spotlight ($29/mo)
spotlight.title: Privacy Notes for Spotlight Listings
spotlight.intro: A Spotlight listing is a paid tier ($29/month) and unlocks more listing fields and a full analytics dashboard, so we process more data than for Verified.
points: We collect and display opening hours and up to eight listing images you provide (with Google-sourced images used as a fallback).

We process a full analytics dashboard for you: views, saves, clicks, likes, dislikes, shares, “Ask AI” and “More Images” clicks, every contact/conversion click, weekly trends, and a performance score.

Your performance score is calculated from your recent activity, engagement, conversion clicks, and how complete your profile is. It is used to rank listings within a zone and to decide displacement when a zone is full.
Because this is a paid tier, we process subscription and payment-related data through our payment provider (see “Payments and Billing”).
In a full zone, a Spotlight listing may displace the lowest-performing free listing; the outcome is recorded on the affected listings.

signature.label: Signature ($49/mo)
signature.title: Privacy Notes for Signature Listings
signature.intro: A Signature listing is our top paid tier (from $49/month) and unlocks the most features, so it involves the most data processing — including images we host for you and competitive analytics.
points: We collect everything a Spotlight listing does, plus social media links (Instagram, Facebook, TripAdvisor, Booking.com), listing highlights, and optional “Hidden Gem” status.
Images you upload are stored as files within our database and are served publicly by URL so travellers can see them. You can delete them at any time from your dashboard.

Zone Intelligence shows you competitive insight about your map zone. You can see competitors' names, tiers, approximate locations, and performance shown only as fuzzed ranges (never exact). In turn, your business name, tier, and approximate location are visible to other Signature owners in the same zone, and your listing name, tier, and coordinates appear in the public zone-availability check.
If your zone is held by three Signature listings, you may join the Zone Auction. We then process your bid amounts, bid timing, defend responses, and the agreed locked price.
Your dashboard shows an estimated revenue figure derived from conversion clicks and your stated pricing. It is an estimate only and is not based on real sales data.
Subscription and payment-related data is processed through our payment provider (see “Payments and Billing”).

common.title: The Business Account We Create for You
common.content: When you submit a business application we automatically create an owner account for you, using your contact email. If you provide only a phone number, we generate a placeholder login address based on that number. We email you a secure, time-limited link (valid for 24 hours) so you can set your own password and access your dashboard. If the email already belongs to an existing Jinni account, we reuse it and leave your existing password unchanged.

common.title: Information You Provide
common.content: When you register or edit a listing we collect: your business name and categories; short and detailed descriptions and highlights; your address, city, region, country and map coordinates; contact details (email, phone, website) and social media links; pricing; opening hours; event dates and the venue's time zone; and any images you upload. We also record which information you choose to make public, such as whether your email address is shown.

common.title: How We Verify Your Listing
common.content: To confirm that a listing is genuine, we run automated verification when you apply. This means some of the information you submit is sent to third parties: we query the Google Places API using your business name and location and may retrieve and store matching photos and details; we fetch your website, TripAdvisor page, and Instagram profile (if provided) to check that your business name appears; and we may send your address to OpenStreetMap/Nominatim for geocoding. These checks produce an automated score and notes that our staff use when reviewing your listing. A human reviewer approves or rejects every listing.

common.title: How We Use Business Information
points: To create and operate your listing and owner account.
To verify that your business is genuine and to review it for quality and safety.
To display your listing to travellers, including through search, map discovery, and the Jinni AI assistant.
To produce the analytics and performance scores shown on your dashboard.
To manage zones, displacement, and (for Signature) the Zone Auction.
To process payments for paid tiers and to contact you about your listing.
To detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and duplicate or bad-faith listings.

common.title: Information Made Public on Jinni
common.content: An approved, active listing is shown to travellers. Publicly visible information includes your business name, description, categories, address and coordinates, images, opening hours, pricing, and contact links such as phone, website, and social media. Your email address is shown only if you turn on the “show email” option. Moderation details — such as the IP your application came from, internal review notes, and our abuse flags — are never shown publicly.

common.title: Sharing With Third Parties
common.content: We share business information with service providers only as needed to run Jinni: Google (Places data and photos) and OpenStreetMap/Nominatim for verification and mapping; OpenAI, to which we send only your business name as part of generating AI recommendations (not your contact details, exact location, pricing, or social links); our email provider for transactional messages; and our payment provider for paid tiers. We may also disclose information where required by law or to protect the rights, safety, and security of Jinni, our users, and the public.

common.title: Analytics and Performance Data
common.content: We record how travellers interact with your listing — views, clicks, saves, shares, reactions, “Ask AI” actions, and contact/conversion clicks — and keep weekly snapshots and a performance score. Some of these interaction events are stored in a way that links the action to the traveller's account as well as to your listing. Aggregate counts power your dashboard. Estimated revenue (Signature) is calculated from conversion clicks and your stated pricing and is an estimate only.

common.title: Safety, Abuse Prevention, and Fingerprints
common.content: To stop fraudulent, duplicate, or bad-faith listings we capture and retain the IP address your application was submitted from, and we create “fingerprints” based on email, phone number, business name and city, IP address, and account ID. We check these against an internal block-list. If a listing is permanently rejected for abuse, we may block these fingerprints from future applications and disable the associated owner login. We never tell an applicant which specific detail caused a block. Repeated rejections sharing the same email or phone may be flagged automatically.

common.title: Payments and Billing
common.content: Paid tiers (Spotlight and Signature) are billed on a monthly basis, and Zone Auction outcomes may set a higher monthly price that is locked for a period. Payments are intended to be processed through a third-party payment gateway; we store billing records such as amount, currency, method, billing period, a gateway transaction reference, and payment status. We do not store full card details on our own servers. The exact payment methods, currency, billing cycle, and refund terms are described in our Business Terms of Service.

common.title: Data Storage and Security
common.content: Business data is stored in our managed cloud database. Images you upload, and photos we retrieve from Google during verification, are stored within that database and served over the web; uploaded and cached images are publicly accessible by URL and may be cached for a period. We apply technical and organisational measures to protect your information, and access to moderation tools is limited to authorised staff and administrators.

common.title: Data Retention
common.content: We keep your listing and associated data for as long as your account and listing exist. Some records are kept longer for safety and audit reasons — for example, the submission IP and the review history of a listing, and block-list fingerprints, which can outlive the listing that produced them. When a listing is deleted by an administrator, its detailed interaction analytics are removed, while the review/audit trail may be retained.

common.title: Your Choices and Rights
points: View and update most of your listing details from your dashboard (some fields depend on your tier).
Control whether your email address is shown publicly.
Delete images you have uploaded.
Cancel a paid subscription; for Signature listings this is handled through the auction/cancellation flow.

Request access to, correction of, or deletion of your business and owner-account data by contacting us. Some data may be retained where we have a legal or legitimate-interest basis, such as fraud prevention.

common.title: Changes to This Policy
common.content: We may update this Business Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes we will update the “Last Updated” date and, where appropriate, notify you. Your continued use of Jinni for Business after an update means you accept the revised policy.

common.title: Contact Us
common.content: If you have questions about this Business Privacy Policy or how we handle your business data, please contact us through the Contact page on Jinni.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Jinni ('we', 'our', or 'us') is an AI-powered travel companion. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information. By using Jinni, you agree to this policy.

account.title: Account Information
account.content: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and password (hashed, never stored in plain text). If you sign up with Google, we receive basic profile information from Google, including your Google ID, display name, and profile photo.

preferences.title: Travel Preferences
preferences.content: We collect your travel style, interests, budget preferences (amount and currency), and preferred languages to personalise recommendations.

location.title: Location Data
location.content: We collect location in three ways: 1) Manually – you select a city or drop a pin on the map. 2) Auto‑detected (with your permission) – we may use your GPS coordinates to refine recommendations. You can turn this off in settings at any time. 3) IP‑based fallback – if you have not set a location and location permissions are not granted, we may use your IP address to estimate your approximate location as a one‑time fallback. This estimate is not stored unless you explicitly save it.

usage.title: Usage Information
usage.content: We automatically collect AI conversations, places you view or interact with (e.g., tapping 'directions' or 'website'), search queries, and features you use to improve our service.

device.title: Device & Technical Information
device.content: We collect IP address (temporarily for security), browser type, operating system, and device type.

use.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
points: Provide and improve Jinni’s AI recommendations and features.
Personalise your experience based on preferences and location.
Authenticate your account and prevent fraud (including temporarily blocking suspicious IPs).
Send service updates, verification codes, password reset emails, and (with your consent) promotional messages.
Analyse usage patterns to enhance the service.
Comply with legal obligations.

sharing.title: 3. Information Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell your personal information. We share data only with:

service.title: Service Providers
service.content:
We rely on trusted third parties to operate Jinni. They are contractually bound to use your data only for the services we request.

- Google OAuth (for sign‑in with Google)
- Google Places & Geocoding APIs (for place search, details, and reverse geocoding)
- Open‑Meteo (for weather data)
- Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) (for location search on the map)
- IP geolocation services (for approximate location fallback)
- SendGrid (for sending emails)
- OpenAI / DeepSeek (for AI model responses – no personally identifying information is sent)

legal.title: Legal Requirements
legal.content: We may disclose your information if required by law or in response to a valid legal request.

business.title: Business Transfers
business.content: If Jinni is merged, acquired, or sold, your information may be transferred. We will notify you before any such change.

ai.title: 4. AI and Data Processing
ai.content: When you chat with Jinni, your message is processed by a third‑party AI model. The AI receives your message, preferences, effective location (your saved destination or, with permission, your real‑time location), and contextual data (weather, nearby places). No personally identifying information (name, email, account ID) is sent to the AI. We store conversation history to maintain context. You can delete individual sessions or your entire chat history at any time.

storage.title: 5. Data Storage and Security
storage.content: Your information is stored on servers in Europe and the United States. We use industry‑standard measures: encryption in transit (TLS/SSL), encryption at rest (passwords hashed, other sensitive data encrypted), and strict access controls. No system is completely secure, but we strive to protect your information.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.content: We keep your information as long as your account is active. Account and preferences are kept until you delete your account. Chat sessions can be deleted earlier individually. Email verification codes are deleted shortly after issuance; password reset codes are deleted within a short period. IP addresses are stored temporarily with security records and automatically removed. Blocked IPs are unblocked after a short period. If you delete your account, all account data, chat sessions, and usage limits are permanently removed. Analytics events may be retained in aggregated form.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.content: Depending on your location (e.g., EEA, UK, California), you may have the right to:
points: Access – request a copy of your personal data.
Correct – update inaccurate information through your account settings.
Delete – delete your account and all associated data.
Opt out – unsubscribe from marketing emails; disable location auto‑detection.
Portability – receive your data in a structured format.
Withdraw consent – where consent is required (e.g., location), you can change your settings at any time.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain your login session, remember your preferences (language, theme), and analyse usage (in‑house analytics only). You can control cookies through your browser settings.

children.title: 9. Children’s Privacy
children.content: Jinni is not intended for users under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If we become aware, we will delete it immediately.

international.title: 10. International Users
international.content: If you are outside Europe or the United States, your information may be transferred to countries with different data protection laws. By using Jinni, you consent to such transfers. For EEA users: we process data based on contract performance, legitimate interests, consent, or legal obligations. You may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this policy. Material changes will be notified by email or a prominent notice on our site. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your privacy rights, please contact us through our support channels or email us at privacy{'@'}jinni.ai.
